connector.name: Heu MCP by Lucav21
connector.registryDescription: HEU Legal e-signature MCP: manage HEU documents and PDFs, prompt signers, download PDFs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package heu-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lucav21 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HEU_API_KEY
env.description: HEU Legal API key (Profile > API Keys, Enterprise plan required)

env.name: HEU_DOWNLOAD_DIR
env.description: Directory where downloaded PDFs are saved. Default: /tmp
